fields.title: Urgent: Upgrade Log4j from 2.14.1 to 2.24.3
fields.body:
Log4j has 2 new releases on Maven Central (org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core) newer than our version 2.14.1:
- 2.24.3
- 2.17.1

Our version has 1 known vulnerability:
- CVE-2021-44228 (critical, CVSS 10, reported by OSV and NVD). Log4Shell Fixed in 2.15.0. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-44228

Proposed by the AI workflow builder.
